$comment: What each Expo SDK line expects of the packages, tools and toolchain that move with it. Read by check-sdk-alignment.mjs and check-sdk-trigger.mjs; every key is described in references/sdk-lines.md. Version fields ending in a minor ("19.3") or a major ("30") are line prefixes; full versions are exact. An app that moves before this file knows its SDK adds the entry to its own contracts/expo-sdk-lines.json (same shape), which replaces this file's entry for that SDK.
$stackPins: stack-pin-ignore-file: this table describes several Expo SDK lines on purpose

55.status: stable, older: npm sdk-55 = 55.0.31; verified 2026-10-04 (bundledNativeModules.json of expo 55.0.31, api.expo.dev relatedPackages, react-native 0.83.10 gradle/libs.versions.toml, docs.expo.dev versions table and v55 build-properties page, EAS build infrastructure page). Written after the SDK shipped: removedApis lists nothing for it.

removedAppConfigKeys.fix: Delete newArchEnabled: since SDK 55 the New Architecture is the only architecture and the key is gone from the app config schema.
Delete android.edgeToEdgeEnabled: Android 16 (targetSdk 36) enforces edge to edge, the key left the app config schema in SDK 55; lay content out with safe-area insets.

56.status: stable, older: npm sdk-56 = 56.0.23; verified 2026-10-04 (bundledNativeModules.json of expo 56.0.23, api.expo.dev relatedPackages, react-native 0.85.3 gradle/libs.versions.toml, docs.expo.dev versions table and v56 build-properties page, EAS build infrastructure page). Every SDK 56 release carries the Hermes V1 memory regression of SDK 57's advisory: move on to SDK 57. Written after the SDK shipped: removedApis lists nothing for it.

removedAppConfigKeys.fix: Delete newArchEnabled: since SDK 55 the New Architecture is the only architecture and the key is gone from the app config schema.
Delete android.edgeToEdgeEnabled: Android 16 (targetSdk 36) enforces edge to edge, the key left the app config schema in SDK 55; lay content out with safe-area insets.

57.status: stable: npm latest 57.0.26; verified 2026-10-04 (bundledNativeModules.json of expo 57.0.26, api.expo.dev relatedPackages, react-native 0.86.3 gradle/libs.versions.toml, docs.expo.dev versions table (Xcode 26.4+, iOS 16.4+) and v57 app config and build-properties pages, EAS build infrastructure page). Re-read 2026-10-17 against bundledNativeModules.json of expo 57.0.27 (the newest SDK 57 patch past the 7-day release age; npm sdk-57 = 57.0.30): patch specifiers of Expo modules only, React Native 0.86.3 and every key of this entry unchanged. Written as the current SDK: removedApis lists nothing for it.
57.advisory: Expo's expo-upgrade skill (expo/skills, read 2026-10-04): SDK 55 with Hermes V1 enabled, every SDK 56 release and SDK 57 before expo 57.0.9 carry a Hermes V1 memory regression that can drastically increase memory use with react-native-worklets or react-native-reanimated; apps on SDK 55 move straight to SDK 57 (57.0.9 or newer), skipping 56

removedAppConfigKeys.fix: Delete newArchEnabled: since SDK 55 the New Architecture is the only architecture and the key is gone from the app config schema.
Delete android.edgeToEdgeEnabled: Android 16 (targetSdk 36) enforces edge to edge, the key left the app config schema in SDK 55; lay content out with safe-area insets.

58.status: pre-release: npm next 58.0.3 (published 2026-10-03, React Native 0.88.0-rc.3), not npm latest; read 2026-10-04 (the v58 docs versions table confirms Xcode 26.4+, iOS 16.4+ and compileSdk 37). Re-read every value from the stable release in the move commit.

jestConfigMustInclude.why: Reanimated 4.7 and Worklets 0.13 load their native initializers under Jest without it ('[Reanimated] setCSSEventHandler is not available in JSReanimated'); the resolver picks the web implementations (Reanimated's testing guide)
jestConfigMustInclude.fix: Add resolver: 'react-native-reanimated/jest/resolver' to the options every Jest project shares: the top-level config, or each entry of projects (for example the SHARED object of the reference jest.config.js unit-and-component-tests ships).

jestConfigMustInclude.why: jest-expo 58 maps react-native/asset-registry to react-native/src/asset-registry, which React Native 0.88's exports map hides from that resolver ('Could not locate module react-native/asset-registry mapped as react-native/src/asset-registry')
jestConfigMustInclude.fix: Add '^react-native/asset-registry$': '<rootDir>/node_modules/react-native/src/asset-registry.js' as the first moduleNameMapper entry of every Jest project: the top-level config, or each entry of projects (for example the PATH_ALIASES object of the reference jest.config.js unit-and-component-tests ships).

removedApis.fix: Split the long task into smaller ones and schedule them with requestIdleCallback (React Native 0.88 throws 'InteractionManager has been removed from react-native core' in development).
Use animationType ("none" | "slide" | "fade"); React Native 0.88's Modal has no animated prop.
Remove it; React Native 0.88's StatusBar has no backgroundColor (edge to edge on Android: colour the view behind the bar).
Remove it; React Native 0.88's StatusBar has no translucent (edge to edge is the only mode; safe-area insets place content).

Use the full matcher name (toHaveBeenCalled, toHaveBeenCalledTimes, toHaveBeenCalledWith, toHaveBeenLastCalledWith, toHaveBeenNthCalledWith, toHaveReturned, toHaveReturnedTimes, toHaveReturnedWith, toHaveLastReturnedWith, toHaveNthReturnedWith, toThrow); Jest 29 has them too, so fix it before the move.

removedAppConfigKeys.fix: Delete newArchEnabled: since SDK 55 the New Architecture is the only architecture and the key is gone from the app config schema.
Delete android.edgeToEdgeEnabled: Android 16 (targetSdk 36) enforces edge to edge, the key left the app config schema in SDK 55; lay content out with safe-area insets.
